resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO
resources.notes: DFT code for structural relaxation and force calculations; any DFT code capable of producing accurate force constants can substitute.

resources.name: phonopy
resources.notes: Python package to compute second-order force constants and phonon dispersion from finite-displacement DFT results.

resources.name: thirdorder.py
resources.notes: Script from the ShengBTE project to compute third-order force constants from finite-displacement calculations.

resources.name: ShengBTE
resources.notes: Solver for the phonon Boltzmann transport equation to compute thermal conductivity, scattering rates, and weighted phase spaces.

resources.name: Boron pseudopotential for Quantum ESPRESSO
resources.notes: Ultrasoft or projected augmented-wave pseudopotential for boron, e.g., from PSLibrary 1.0.0.
